message: Thanks for being clear about your terms. Our system only supports a fixed set of terms: price, volume min/max, share paid at shipment, lead time, grace period, late-penalty rules, cancel window and deemed-acceptance window. We can't add payment_terms_days or steel_index_bps to the agreement, and we can't offer an index-linked price. We can agree a fixed price per unit. If you'd like to continue, send a price and volume within those terms and we'll work from there.
